name: Cap-It
description: Cap-It is a variation of Push (Contract Rummy family) where players compete individually over 5 rounds with increasing contract requirements. Unlike Push which uses partnerships, Cap-It is every player for themselves. Players contribute to a pot and winners collect from it each round.

content.text: Cap-It is a variation of Push (Contract Rummy family) where players compete individually over 5 rounds with increasing contract requirements. Unlike Push which uses partnerships, Cap-It is every player for themselves. Players contribute to a pot and winners collect from it each round.

Cap-It is a variation of Push, a Contract Rummy game contributed by Paul Welty. The Cap-It variant was described by Wayne Ostrowski. It modifies Push by eliminating partnerships, dealing 10 cards each round, and changing the fifth round contract.
4-6 players, each playing individually (no partnerships). For 4 players: 2 decks. For 5-6 players: 3 decks.
4 players: 108 cards (2Ã—52-card packs + 4 jokers). 5-6 players: 162 cards (3Ã—52-card packs + 6 jokers). Jokers and 2s are wild. Cards rank A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2 (Ace high or low in runs).
2 or 3 standard 52-card packs with jokers, chips/money for pot, score sheet
All 5 rounds deal 10 cards to each player (unlike Push which increases). Remaining cards form stock. Turn up one card to start discard pile (cannot be wild - if 2 or joker, bury and turn up next).
